ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR33] Requires Digital Use Case while in Solutioning, Negotiation or BV, Digitization/InfoGov/InSight deals. PPL corrected per IRM. Stage inferred from sibling rules - confirm if different.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Digitization'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Information Governance'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'InSight') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISPICKVAL(InSight_Opportunities__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Digital Use Case is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
